validation.download_method: Official GitHub contents API download_url via Python urllib HTTPS with default certificate verification
validation.git_blob_verification: SHA-1 of b'blob ' + ASCII byte length + NUL + original downloaded bytes; matched GitHub contents API sha for both assets
validation.chinese_sample: 中文简历教育经历项目技能
validation.coverage_note: Complete upstream Noto Sans SC variable TTF, not a Latin-only web subset. Character coverage is that of the upstream font, not a claim to cover every Unicode CJK character.

generated.license_note: Derived fonts remain under OFL-1.1; original copyright, attribution and license name records and the complete OFL.txt are preserved. Upstream source bytes are unchanged.
strategy: Fully instantiate the official variable TrueType font at wght=400 and wght=700 with fontTools.varLib.instancer; do not subset.

Visit nominal Unicode codepoints in ascending order. Keep the first glyph ID and deep-copy glyf plus hmtx/vmtx for every alias, appending glyphOrder without changing existing IDs or composite references.
Rewrite every Unicode cmap subtable consistently; preserve format-14 variation sequences and their alternate glyphs. No input text normalization or substitution.
Preserve GSUB, GPOS, GDEF and BASE layout tables and rename derived font identities to Zhimai Resume Regular/Bold.
generated.reproducibility: Pinned source SHA-256 and fonttools version; fixed codepoint/glyph order, upstream head timestamps, recalcTimestamp=False, sorted sfnt tables, UTF-8/LF CSS, and no build-time timestamps or absolute paths.
